name: dawnlit
description: An explainable, editable daily paper radar for personal websites.

paragraphs: Your morning research signal: an explainable, editable daily feed for trustworthy large language models. Dawnlit is intentionally local-first: it runs without paid APIs, stores browser feedback locally, and adds cloud sync only when configured.

Most paper products optimize one of three things: a large searchable corpus, community popularity, or opaque similarity to saved papers. Dawnlit starts from a different premise: a researcher should own and understand the filter.
can live on a personal website instead of behind a product account.
